name: loop_zone_read
description: Q-19: a body pass reads what the loop's previous element drew, with lines only. From a Blank project: a fullscreen pass in the root (its image is the outside node), a loop over a new body with a fullscreen pass of its own, count 2. The root pass's output onto the zone's left slot makes the loop input color (read from the pass's port, so the copies wait on it); the body pass's output onto the right slot makes the body's output color, carried back into the input. The body pass draws with engine://passthrough, so its input sockets are its shader's: one variadic band. The boundary input color, dropped on the band's end, is the pass's numbered input 0 -- a port the Graph tab writes, with no JSON typed. The engine's second copy then reads the first copy's image. Rename definition... on the zone gives the body a new name the loop follows, and Undo takes it back. Q-21: with LP-6 the root image itself, dropped on the band's end across the zone's edge, is taken too (Q-19 drew from the pass's port because the engine refused it), and the copies read that image.
